summary: The vLLM wheel contains only the Python modules of its own source commit
compatibility: No user action required. Nothing imported the stray modules, so serving is unchanged.
details: Beta and canonical wheels share one native build cache, and Python modules that a build of the other branch had staged there were packaged too: beta 39ac37fa42 carried 8 canonical-only modules and canonical 502d6cb5ac 7 beta-only ones.
The wheel build now removes the staged Python before building. Compiled objects stay cached, so build time is unchanged.
